own_review.changed: none. Plan mode was active for this run (read-only), so I made no edits, WP-16.md included. Every fix WP-16 needs is listed below in cross with target WP-16, and the orchestrator or a non-plan rerun can apply them. Wave 2 / depends WP-01 is correct: no same-wave WP owns geo11.rs or tests/geo11.rs.

incoming.problem: It uses ApiError::ViewerMissing, but ApiError is a struct. It also cites WP-23 for the Decky zip.
incoming.fix: Use ApiError::new("not-found",&format!("flat3d-viewer not found at {}…")) and have tests check that e.code is "not-found". Change WP-23 to WP-22.

incoming.problem: viewer_check uses `ApiError::ViewerMissing(path)`, but ApiError is a struct `{code,message}` (inject/src/api.rs:89) with no variants. The 'Assumptions about WP-01' bullet repeats this. The test asserts `Err(ApiError::ViewerMissing(_))`.
incoming.fix: Signature comment: `Err(ApiError::new("not-found", &format!("flat3d-viewer not found at {}; reinstall flat-to-3d (install, AppImage or Decky zip)", p.display())))` unless the path is a regular file with any x bit (`std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt`, mode & 0o111). Test: `e.code == "not-found"` and `e.message` contains `flat3d-viewer not found`. Drop the 'ApiError has the variant ViewerMissing' assumption. 'not-found' is already one of the 8 ERROR_CODES.

incoming.problem: `apply returns its to_string()`: ApiError has no Display impl (api.rs:88-101 derives only Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Serialize/Deserialize), so this does not compile.
incoming.fix: `viewer_check(viewer_exe).map_err(|e| e.message)?` as the first line of apply.

incoming.problem: The Viewer-shipping flag says 'WP-23 (Decky zip)'. WP-23 is the app Games page. WP-22 owns both build-appimage.sh and build-decky.sh.
incoming.fix: Change it to 'WP-22 (AppImage and Decky zip) bundles it in bin/'.

incoming.problem: The signature block defines its own `pub type RouteSettings` ('or recipes::RouteSettings if…') and its own `pub const KEYS`. WP-01 freezes `recipes::RouteSettings` and `recipes::GEO11_KEYS:[&str;7]`, and bones names recipes.rs the single owner of route keys.
incoming.fix: Delete both lines. Add `use crate::recipes::{RouteSettings, GEO11_KEYS};` and `use crate::injectors::RouteEnv; use crate::api::ApiError; use crate::undo::{UndoRecord, Replaced}; use crate::injectors::uevr::MARKER_FILE;`. Read the key names from GEO11_KEYS.

incoming.problem: Rollback is described as 'the way uevr.rs:133 does', but that `rollback` is private and WP-14 rewrites uevr.rs in the same wave. 'Rename the old file to <name>.flat3d-backup' also breaks the rollback test: when E/d3d11.dll is a directory, fs::rename succeeds on Linux, so apply never fails.
incoming.fix: Spell it out inline: back up each overwritten file with fs::copy to `<name>.flat3d-partial`, then rename that to `<name>.flat3d-backup` (as uevr::write_all does), so a directory at the destination makes fs::copy fail. Remove steps may rename. A private `fn rollback(&UndoRecord)` renames each replaced backup over its path in reverse, then removes created files in reverse.

incoming.problem: The tree-unchanged / snapshot checks don't say whether directories count. Directories are created but not recorded (ShaderFixes sorts before d3d11.dll, so it exists before the rollback trigger and after undo), so a check that includes dirs fails.
incoming.fix: Tests: 'snapshot = sorted list of (relative path, bytes) of regular files only; directories are ignored'. Use it for the rollback, second-apply, missing-viewer and undo checks.

incoming.problem: Under the ini set rule, the d3dxdm.ini keys (direct_mode, dm_separation, dm_convergence) have no known section. A fixture or real file that lacks them returns the misleading `d3dx.ini has no <key> line`. The fixture contents for d3dx.ini and d3dxdm.ini are unspecified, so the Control and Lana tests cannot be written deterministically.
incoming.fix:
Rule: in d3dxdm.ini, a key with no active or commented line is appended at the end of the file. The error text uses the real file name: `<file> has no <key> line`. Fixtures: x64/d3dxdm.ini = "direct_mode=sbs
dm_separation=30
dm_convergence=1.0
"; x32 files contain "x32" so a wrong pick is visible; control-fix/d3dx.ini = "[Stereo]
force_stereo = 0
[Device]
;get_resolution_from = depth_buffer
". The Lana fixture is lana-fix/Planet of Lana/{d3dx.ini,d3d11.dll,d3dxdm.ini} (exercises the depth rule). Lana expects: no step's `from` is under <cache>/geo11, and a d3dxdm.ini Write with direct_mode=sbs.

incoming.problem: `<cache>/geo11/**/x64/` is ambiguous when several x64 dirs exist. The sidecar's first element type is unstated.
incoming.fix: Overlay dir = the first `x64` directory at depth ≤ 3 in sorted path order. Sidecar[0] = `viewer_exe.to_string_lossy().into_owned()`.

incoming.problem: In the done-check, CARGO_TARGET_DIR prefixes only the first command, so the clippy after && builds into crates' default target/.
incoming.fix: `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<scratch>/target; cargo test --locked -p flat3d-inject --test geo11 && cargo clippy --locked -p flat3d-inject --all-targets -- -D warnings`
